007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.Feedback;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for submitting Select AI feedback for a profile.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
021 * {@link Feedback} request, open a {@link Profile}, call
022 * {@link Profile#feedback(Feedback)}, and print whether the submission
023 * succeeded.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>This sample changes database state by adding or deleting feedback guidance
026 * for generated SQL.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>The supplied SQL identifier or SQL text must refer to a Select AI generated
029 * SQL statement that {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI.FEEDBACK} can find. For repeatable
030 * integration testing, prefer {@code SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_SQL_ID} from a known
031 * Select AI statement.</p>
032 *
033 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
034 * <ul>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
039 *   <li>Exactly one of SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_SQL_ID or SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_SQL_TEXT</li>
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
043 * <ul>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_TYPE - defaults to {@code positive}.</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_CONTENT - defaults to sample feedback text.</li>
046 *   <li>SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_RESPONSE - required by the model when feedback type is negative.</li>
047 *   <li>SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_OPERATION - optional; when omitted,
048 *       {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI.FEEDBACK} applies its database default.</li>
049 * </ul>
050 *
051 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
052 * <pre>{@code
053 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
054 * }</pre>
055 *
056 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
057 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
058 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
059 * <pre>{@code
060 * mvn clean install
061 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
062 * }</pre>
063 *
064 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
065 * <pre>{@code
066 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/SubmitFeedbackProfileSample.java
067 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.SubmitFeedbackProfileSample
068 * }</pre>
069 *
070 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
071 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
072 * and diagnostics.</p>
073 */
074public final class SubmitFeedbackProfileSample {
075    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SubmitFeedbackProfileSample.class);
076
077    private SubmitFeedbackProfileSample() {
078    }
079
080    public static void main(String[] args) {
081        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
082
083        try {
084            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
085            Profile profile = selectAI.profile(profileName);
086            Feedback feedback = buildFeedback();
087            boolean submitted = profile.feedback(feedback);
088
089            System.out.printf("Submit feedback completed: %s%n", submitted);
090            System.out.printf("Profile: %s%n", profileName);
091            System.out.printf("Feedback type: %s%n", feedback.getFeedbackType());
092            System.out.printf("Operation: %s%n", feedback.getOperation());
093        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
094            LOGGER.error("Failed to submit feedback for Select AI profile '{}'.", profileName, e);
095        }
096    }
097
098    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
099        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
100                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
101                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
102                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
103                .build();
104
105        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
106    }
107
108    private static Feedback buildFeedback() {
109        String sqlId = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_SQL_ID");
110        String sqlText = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_SQL_TEXT");
111        boolean hasSqlId = hasText(sqlId);
112        boolean hasSqlText = hasText(sqlText);
113
114        if (hasSqlId == hasSqlText) {
115            throw new IllegalStateException(
116                    "Provide exactly one of SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_SQL_ID or SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_SQL_TEXT");
117        }
118
119        Feedback.FeedbackType feedbackType = Feedback.FeedbackType.from(
120                envOrDefault("SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_TYPE", "positive"));
121        Feedback.Builder builder = Feedback.builder()
122                .feedbackType(feedbackType)
123                .feedbackContent(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_CONTENT", "Approved by Java SDK sample."))
124                .operation(optionalEnv("SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_OPERATION"));
125
126        if (hasSqlId) {
127            builder.sqlId(sqlId);
128        } else {
129            builder.sqlText(sqlText);
130        }
131
132        String response = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_FEEDBACK_RESPONSE");
133        if (hasText(response)) {
134            builder.response(response);
135        }
136
137        return builder.build();
138    }
139
140    private static boolean hasText(String value) {
141        return value != null && !value.isBlank();
142    }
143
144    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
145        String value = System.getenv(name);
146        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
147            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
148        }
149        return value;
150    }
151
152    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
153        String value = System.getenv(name);
154        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
155    }
156
157    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
158        String value = System.getenv(name);
159        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
160    }
161}
